description: The organization's Zitadel login policy. configure-zitadel.sh makes the organization use exactly these values over Zitadel's instance default; the decision lives here and only here.
allow_register_reason: Staff accounts are created by an administrator and pre-provisioned in each console; a public sign-up button let anyone who reached the issuer create an account.
allow_external_idp_reason: No external identity provider is configured; the switch stays off until one is decided.
ignore_unknown_usernames_reason: The login screen does not reveal whether an account exists.
force_mfa_reason: The staff consoles are reachable from the internet behind Cloudflare Access (root ADR-0434 §3); a password alone must not open the approve button. A staff member without a second factor is asked to enrol one (OTP app or security key) at the next sign-in.
